youtube.title: Morning Prayer for Today | Romans 15:13 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Running low on hope? Paul prayed this over people just like you.

"Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost." Romans 15:13 (KJV)

The joy and peace come in believing, not from how the week's been going.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.
